name: Chat Thread
summary: Every slide is a screen of a messaging conversation: the audience asks in white bubbles on the left, the creator answers in accent bubbles on the right, on a pale canvas tinted to match.

accent.use: the sent bubbles, the big stat value, the photo rim, the send button, the cursor, the back arrow, the author name and the reaction heart; the canvas, pills and grey text are pale or dark tints of its hue. Bright accents are darkened so white text on the bubbles keeps 4.5:1
